corpus_reference.full_reference_filter: all molecules rows, including excluded/duplicate rows
corpus_reference.inchikey_matching: full 27-character key equality; source keys may be source-reported, not recomputed
corpus_reference.training_exposure_note: Prepared included train partition, not proof that every row was consumed by a particular checkpoint

source_manifest_metadata.all_corpus_membership_filter: all rows, including length exclusions and duplicates
source_manifest_metadata.raw_audit: raw_row_json preserves every input field; smiles preserves the original string

tpsa.unit: angstrom^2; calculated topological polar surface area

qed.unit: dimensionless calculated QED descriptor; not a probability

definitions.validity: RDKit parsed/sanitized nonempty SMILES; names, whitespace and CXSMILES are not accepted; no repair
definitions.termination: Explicit EOS flag supplied by generator; not inferred from validity
definitions.unique_structure: Full standard InChIKey; canonical isomeric SMILES fallback when unavailable
definitions.uniqueness_denominator: All valid samples, including nonterminated samples
definitions.novelty_denominator: Unique valid structures, including nonterminated samples; no denominator switching
definitions.novelty_match: Known if full InChIKey OR available canonical_isomeric_smiles column matches
definitions.unknown_novelty: Rate is null if any unique valid identity cannot be checked or no reference supplied
definitions.identity_processing: No salt stripping, neutralization or manual tautomer standardization; standard InChI applies its own normalization
definitions.computed_properties: RDKit calculations summarized over one representative per unique valid structure; not experimental measurements

limitations: Valid or exactly novel SMILES do not establish natural occurrence, synthesis, drug suitability or clinical benefit.
Novelty is limited to this frozen reference and identity policy, not all known molecules or scientific novelty.
Prepared train membership is not a per-checkpoint memorization/exposure audit.
Standard InChI may equate representations that have different canonical SMILES; both unique counts are reported.
No similarity, scaffold novelty, biological activity, disease indication or calibrated clinical probability is evaluated.
Wildcard atoms, radicals and disconnected fragments are flagged but RDKit syntactic validity alone does not exclude them.
